summary: The tzdata index parser processes trailing partial entries with chunks(), then slices them as complete entries, potentially panicking out of bounds. The fix uses chunks_exact() to skip incomplete entries. The regression test added by the fix supplies a 20-byte index region and expects an empty index; reversing the iterator change should cause the 40-byte name slice to panic. No tests were run.
expected_failure: range end index 40 out of range for slice of length 20
